SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) AS n_rows,
       count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) AS n_keys,
       count(DISTINCT store_key) AS stores, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads,
       min(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load,
       sum(closing_value) AS val
FROM fact_stock_week
WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH w AS (
  SELECT *, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY store_key, product_key) AS c
  FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date = DATE '2026-03-08'
), d AS (
  SELECT store_key, product_key, count(*) c,
         count(DISTINCT closing_units) du, count(DISTINCT closing_value) dv,
         count(DISTINCT receipts_units) dr, count(DISTINCT adjustment_units) da
  FROM w WHERE c > 1 GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT count(*) AS dup_keys, sum(c) AS dup_rows, sum(CASE WHEN du>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS differ_units,
       sum(CASE WHEN dv>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS differ_value, sum(CASE WHEN dr>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS differ_rec,
       sum(CASE WHEN da>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS differ_adj, count(DISTINCT store_key) AS stores_involved
FROM d
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, count(*), NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL, NULL FROM w WHERE etl_loaded_at = TIMESTAMP '2026-03-09 01:00:00'
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, count(*), NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL, NULL FROM w WHERE etl_loaded_at = TIMESTAMP '2026-03-10 02:45:00'

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-02-23' AS start_date, DATE '2026-03-22' AS end_date
),
stock_dedup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_units, closing_value
    FROM fact_stock_week, params
    WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT sd.week_ending_date, cp.category, SUM(sd.closing_value) AS closing_value, count(*) AS n
    FROM stock_dedup sd
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = sd.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = sd.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE cs.region = 'West' AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT category, count(*) AS weeks, round(avg(closing_value), 2) AS avg_stock_value,
       min(n) AS minrows, max(n) AS maxrows, min(closing_value) AS minv, max(closing_value) AS maxv
FROM weekly GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH sd AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.store_key, f.product_key, f.week_ending_date, f.closing_units, f.closing_value, s.store_id, p.sku, p.category, p.delisted_on, p.standard_unit_cost
  FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
)
SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT (store_id, sku)) AS n_store_sku,
       sum(CASE WHEN closing_units < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_units,
       sum(CASE WHEN closing_value < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_val,
       sum(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_rows,
       sum(CASE WHEN store_id >= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonphys,
       sum(CASE WHEN delisted_on IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delisted_rows,
       sum(CASE WHEN abs(closing_value - closing_units*standard_unit_cost) > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value_mismatch
FROM sd GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
